description: World-given premises the model relies on, with owner, status, and a status note. They are not implementation obligations.

assumptions.title: path is identity (keyed state, identity runs)
assumptions.status_note: Upheld by construction; no dedicated falsification test.

assumptions.title: content identified by hash (snapshot comparison)
assumptions.status_note: Imposed and tested; finite model bounds allow collisions the real hash function must not produce.

assumptions.title: filesystem is the source of truth: asset bytes, path, sidecar
assumptions.owner: sweep (per root) plus rescan reconciliation rebuild every derived table and thumbnail from media bytes and sidecar; sidecar copy-before-rename in move paths (assign_album.rs::move_asset_into_album) and atomic tree renames (move_album_into_album) keep the sidecar with the asset
assumptions.status_note: The system converges based on the filesystem as the primary truth; the redb tables and the thumbnail store are secondary and exist for speed and caching only. Loss, orphaning or tearing of derived state is not a goal violation because rescan rebuilds it from media bytes and sidecar. DB-only non-derived state (share_list, album access state) is the enumerated exception and must be individually guarded; user-authored metadata lives in sidecars and survives any pipeline interruption window.

assumptions.title: derived store is pipeline-private (walk roots disjoint)
assumptions.owner: deployment layout (walk roots disjoint from derived store)
assumptions.status_note: Assumed true; no check that walk roots never cover the derived store.

assumptions.title: quiescence (safety invariants asserted at settled state)
assumptions.status_note: Safety invariants are asserted at settled states; scheduling fairness is delegated to ASS-7.

assumptions.title: user enables backstop scans at regular intervals
assumptions.status_note: Assumed operating condition: the user enables the periodic backstop and it runs at regular intervals. Nothing verifies the setting or the interval. The watcher's Flag::Rescan trigger exists only while the watcher is enabled; with the watcher off, the backstop is the sole trigger.
